faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Ross?
faq.answer: Ross homeowners typically invest $18,000 to $50,000+ for window replacement projects. This exclusive Marin County enclave — one of the smallest and wealthiest towns in California — features Tudor Revival, English Country, and Mediterranean estates with custom windows that demand premium specifications. Projects with Marvin Ultimate or Andersen A-Series covering 20–35+ windows are typical. Single window installation starts at approximately $850.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Ross?
faq.answer: Yes. Ross requires a building permit for all window replacements. The Town of Ross is known for thorough architectural review through the Design Review Board, which evaluates all exterior changes for consistency with the town's historic and character-defining standards. Our team manages all Town of Ross permit and design review applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Ross?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Ross commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Ross?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Ross replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Ross?
faq.answer: Most Ross projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
